latest.author: Darkatek7
latest.text: Thanks for the reports! The "helper not ready" and "The theme helper was sent but did not respond" errors on firmware 13.40 and later should be fixed now. The cause: the helper's startup code used the FW 13.00 kernel offset on every 13.x firmware, so the helper stopped before it started listening on 13.40+. The fix is in 01.000.004 and later, and a user on 13.42 confirmed that themes apply now (Darkatek7/ProsperoThemes#1). 13.60 uses the same offset as 13.42, but I couldn't test it there myself…
